summary: Iter55 validated the Discovery/Shop redesign end-to-end. Backend HTTP suite backend/tests/test_iter55_discovery.py: 7/7 passed on public URL. GET /api/brands returns [{name,count,images,sample}] with 'Collector' present. GET /api/characters includes 'count' field per character. GET /api/products?brand=Collector -> X-Total-Count=12 & every row brand==Collector; brand=NopeBrandXYZ -> 0; sort=rating ordering strictly desc by rating_avg; character filter using slug returns items where slug in characters[]; date_night=1 accepted and returns int total. Frontend (desktop 1920): home-discovery-section renders 'Jelajahi dengan caramu.' heading; 'Sedang Trending' NOT present anywhere; all 4 tabs (brand default, character, editor, best) render with discovery-panel-<id> switching via framer-motion; discovery-view-all href mirrors tab (/shop, /shop, /shop?sort=rating, /shop?bestSeller=1). Brand tab: discovery-brand-tile visible, typing 'zzznope' shows discovery-brand-search-empty, clearing restores; tile click navigates to /shop?brand=Collector. Character tab: 12 discovery-character-card rendered, typing 'woody' filters to 1 card. Editor's Picks tab: 10 discovery-editor-pick cards rendered (rating desc order). Best Seller tab: 4 discovery-ranked-product cards rendered with rank numbers. Shop /shop: NO shop-filter-price-range-slider, NO Notes section, NO Ukuran section in ShopFilters.js. Sections rendered: Kategori Aroma, Brand (FacetSearch shop-filter-brand + input shop-filter-brand-input + option shop-filter-brand-option + chip shop-filter-brand-selected 'Collector'), Character (same pattern; focus shows 'Populer' group; typing 'wo' + Enter selects 'Woody' chip), Momen (shop-filter-day-night labelled 'Day & Night' → URL date_night=1), Tier, Tipe, Untuk. Combined URL confirmed: /shop?date_night=1&character=woody&brand=Collector; shop-count reads '2 PRODUK DITEMUKAN · DAY & NIGHT · COLLECTOR · WOODY'; shop-active-filters chips show 'DAY & NIGHT', 'WOODY', 'COLLECTOR' and 'HAPUS SEMUA' resets. Sort dropdown includes rating option. Mobile 390px: discovery-tabs is horizontally scrollable (scrollWidth 658 > clientWidth 348); shop-mobile-filter-button opens shop-filters-sheet-panel with brand/character search inputs and Day & Night toggle. Admin editor uses label 'Day & Night' (AdminProductEditorPage.js:355). ShopByOccasion component hides itself when items.length<2, so single-momen preview correctly does not render the section.
critical_code_review_comments: services/catalog.py list_brands sorts by best_seller then rating_avg before $group; final $sort {count:-1, _id:1} ensures deterministic order. Consider using $addToSet or $group with $first to reduce memory on catalogs >10k products.

components/home/DiscoverySection.js uses AnimatePresence mode='wait' around the discovery-view-all Link's cur.word so background outline word transitions smoothly across tabs — nice touch. Panel key={tab} on motion.div re-mounts child TabBody, which refetches useDiscoveryData per tab; that hook likely already caches — verify to avoid re-hitting /api/products on rapid tab flips.

components/shop/ShopFilters.js: Notes/Size/Price removed as required. Section state persisted in localStorage under 'cp:shop-filter-sections:v3' — good version bump. Character section uses FacetSearch with slug value + name label; selected chips render via shop-filter-character-selected.
components/home/FacetSection.js ShopByOccasion gate '(loading || items.length >= 2)' correctly hides the section when only 1 momen exists — matches acceptance criteria.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Discovery redesign + shop filter overhaul verified. Selectors: home-discovery-section, discovery-tab-{brand|character|editor|best}, discovery-panel-<id>, discovery-view-all, discovery-brand-tile, discovery-brand-search(+ -empty), discovery-character-card, discovery-character-search, discovery-editor-pick, discovery-ranked-product. Shop: shop-filter-brand(+ -input, -option, -selected), shop-filter-character(same pattern), shop-filter-day-night, shop-active-filters, shop-count, shop-mobile-filter-button, shop-filters-sheet-panel. Preview seed still has only 12 products / 1 brand (Collector) — brand tab correctly shows single tile.
